3D graphics (WebGL) are switched off in: Igishushanyo cya 3D (WebGL) kizimye muri iyi mushakisha. Fungura umuvuduko wibyuma muburyo bwa mushakisha hanyuma utangire gushakisha kugirango ubone salle ya 3D.
A “Setu” coin with a bull on the obverse: Igiceri cya "Setu" hamwe n'ikimasa kuruhande. Ijambo Setu - ikiraro kigana i Lanka, ahitwa Rameswaram - kigaragara ku biceri by'abategetsi ba Tamil ba nyuma bo mu kinyejana cya 5 bo mu bwami bwa Jaffna; ikimasa cochant, Nandi ya Shiva, nibikoresho byabo bisanzwe.
A burial urn of the kind that made Adich: Gushyingura ubwoko bwubwoko bwamamaye Adichanallur. Abapfuye - cyangwa amagufwa yabo yakusanyirijwe - bashyizwe mu nkono zirimo ibintu bikomeye kandi bashyingurwa mu butaka bwa kaburimbo hejuru ya Thamirabarani. Urns ni ihuza ritaziguye na முதுமக்கள் தாழி ibisigo bya Sangam.
A catalogue of the coins issued by the C: Urutonde rw'ibiceri byatanzwe n'abami ba Chera, Chola, na Pandya, hamwe n'ibimenyetso byabo bya cyami by'umuheto, ingwe, n'amafi.
A ceramic vessel from Adichanallur. Smal: Icyombo ceramic kuva Adichanallur. Inkono ntoya nkiyi yashyizwe imbere cyangwa iruhande rwabashyinguwe, wenda ifata ibiryo, amazi cyangwa amaturo kubapfuye - incamake yimyizerere yigihe cyicyizere murugendo rurenze urupfu.
A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Igare ryikururuka, shaweli kuri pawusi, imbuto zitanga ubuzima kumusizi: impano zizwi cyane z'abakunzi zisa nkudakwiye, kandi niyo ngingo yabo. Kodai madamu ni ubuntu cyane kuburyo utanga atabara imikoreshereze yimpano - impuhwe zigirira inyamaswa, ibimera ndetse no kwiga kimwe.
A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Igiceri cya Chera mu cyegeranyo cy'inzu ndangamurage ya Napier, Thiruvananthapuram. Ibiceri bya Chera biranga umuheto n'umwambi, ikirango cy'ingoma, n'ingero nyinshi zo hambere zituruka i Karur, ikigo cya Chera kuri Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Umutware wumurongo wa Ay mugihugu cyimisozi yepfo ya Podiyil (Pothigai). Umugenzo uzwi cyane uvuga ku gutanga igitambo cyagaciro ku mana, bakunze kwita Shiva - gutanga nk'ubwitange kimwe n'ubuntu.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Umutware wo mu gisekuru cya Malaiyaman, wo mu gihugu kizengurutse Mullur na Tirukkoyilur, yibutse ko yari afite icyubahiro ku basizi ndetse n'abamusanze bose. Umwanya afite mubarinzi barindwi werekana ko icyubahiro cyumutegetsi cyapimwe no gutanga kwe nkubutaka bwe.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Igiceri cya Chola gitwaye ibirango bya cyami bya Pandya. Igihe Cholas yazanaga igihugu cya Pandya ku butegetsi bwabo, bashyize amafi ya Pandya iruhande rw'ingwe yabo - ikimenyetso cyo kwigarurira icyuma.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Umujyi ubuvanganzo, ubufasha bwa cyami, idini nubuzima bwo mumijyi byahuye mumyaka ibihumbi bibiri.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Igiceri cya Kulottunga Chola cyitiriwe "Malai Nadu konda Chola" - Chola yafashe igihugu cyimisozi, ni ukuvuga igihugu cya Chera. Abami ba Chola batangaje ko batsinze mu mazina yakubiswe ku biceri byabo ndetse no mu nyandiko zabo.
A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Igiceri cya Kulottunga I (1070–1120 IC), wahujije imirongo ya Chola na Chalukya y'Iburasirazuba kandi utegeka imwe mu ngoma ndende kandi itera imbere ya Chola. Ibiceri bye bikomeza ubwoko bwa Chola bwashyizweho n'izina rye muri Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Igiceri cya Rajaraja I. Ibiceri bye byumuringa byumwami uhagaze nubwoko bwicaye, byatangijwe nyuma yo kwigarurira amajyaruguru ya Sri Lanka, byakwirakwijwe cyane kumpande zinyanja kandi byigana ibinyejana byinshi.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Igiceri cyubwami bwa Jaffna cyerekana ifarashi ifite amafi. Abami bo muri Tamil ba Jaffna (ikinyejana cya 13 - 17) batanze ibiceri mu muco gakondo w'Abahinde, bibutsa umubano wa hafi hakurya ya Palk.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Igiceri cya Kongu Cheras, umurongo wa Chera wategekaga igihugu cya Kongu cyo mu burengerazuba bwa Tamil (hafi ya Coimbatore, Erode na Karur) - akarere kamwe katanze ibiceri byinshi by'ibiceri by'Abaroma.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Igishusho cyambitswe ikamba, cyijimye mu mwirondoro, wambaye ikoti rya zahabu na shitingi zitemba, bizamura abakozi bafite amababa. Isura n'amaboko bishushanyije kumurongo mwiza wumukara kubutaka bwerurutse kandi imyenda yogejwe muri ocher, umutuku nicyatsi - ubushakashatsi busa nubushushanyo bwimyambarire yubucamanza mubishushanyo byurusengero.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Ibisobanuro birambuye hejuru yisenge irangi ryurusengero rwubuvumo bwa Jain ahitwa Sittanavasal: lotus yijimye ifungura hagati yicyatsi kibisi, inyamaswa inyura mumazi nigishushanyo cyegeranya indabyo. Ikidendezi gikunze gusomwa nka lotus moat ya samavasarana, iteraniro ryo mwijuru aho Jain Tirthankara abwiriza, hamwe nabizerwa bakusanya indabyo kugirango batange.
A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Icyombo cyo gushyingura kiva mu mva zashyinguwe ku misozi ya Nilgiri, umupfundikizo wacyo wambitswe ibishushanyo mbonera. Abacukuzi bo mu kinyejana cya 19 bo mu bwato bwa Nilgiri basanze imifuniko myinshi yuzuye hejuru y’abantu, inyamaswa ndetse n’abayigenderaho - uduce duto mu ibumba dushobora kwerekana ubuzima n’abapfuye.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Indabyo yimirongo igera kuri ijana na mirongo itanu akam yanditswe na Kanimethaviyar, nka mirongo itatu kuri buri butaka butanu.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Igiceri cya zahabu cya Rajaraja I (985-1014 IC), wubatse urusengero runini i Thanjavur. Irerekana ikirangantego cya cyami cya Chola: ingwe yicaye iruhande rw'amafi abiri ya Pandya, munsi ya parasol y'ubusugire, hamwe n'izina ry'umwami i Nagari - Chola ivuga ko itegeka amajyepfo.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Zahabu igice-kahavanu cya Virarajendra Chola (1063–1070 IC). Kahavanu (ukomoka kuri kahapana) yari idini rya zahabu muri Sri Lanka, kandi zahabu ya Chola yakubiswe kuri iki gipimo igaragaza igihe Chola yategekaga ikirwa.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Umuvugo uyobora Idylls icumi ya Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar. Bard hamwe na yazh nini iyobowe na Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan wa Kanchi; munzira igisigo gishushanya amashusho yimidugudu, ibyambu, nabantu.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Umuvugo uyobora Idylls icumi ya Mudathama Kanniyar. Inanga yo gucuranga ingoma (porunar) yahembwe cyane iyobora bard mugenzi we umwami wa Chola utanga Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Umuvugo uyobora Idylls icumi ya Nallur Nathathanar. Akabari kacuranga azh (inanga) kayobora undi kuri shebuja Nalliyakkodan, asobanura ingorane za bard bakennye n'ubushyuhe bwa patron utanga.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Umuvugo uyobora Idylls icumi ya Perunkausikanar. Abazerera (koothar) bayoborwa n'umuyobozi mukuru Nannan; igisigo cyizihizwa kubera gufata amajwi menshi yimisozi.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Ikibindi kinini cyo kubika gifitanye isano na Adichanallur. Ibibindi bifite ubushobozi byari bifite ingano, amazi nibindi byateganijwe; ahashyinguwe, inzabya zingana nazo zishobora gukora nka urns. Ijambo "dolio" ryibutsa dolium, ikibindi kinini cyo kubikamo isi y'Abaroma.
A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Umuhango munini, uzengurutse inda-urn kuva Adichanallur. Urns nkiyi irashobora guhagarara muremure kuruta umwana, kandi bigatuma basaba ubuhanga bukomeye: Abasizi ba Sangam babwira umubumbyi wakoze inkono nka கலம்செய் கோவே - “Mwami mububumbyi”.
A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Igiceri cyambere cya Andipatti gifite umugani muri Tamil-Brahmi. Usibye abami batatu bambitswe ikamba, abatware baho bo mu gihe cya Sangam batanze ibiceri mu isasu n'umuringa, kandi imigani ya Tamil-Brahmi kuri bo ifasha gushyira amazina abo bategetsi.
A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Igishushanyo cyumurongo wa vimana ninzu yinkingi yurusengero rwa Brihadisvara.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Igisigo cyurukundo cya Ten Idylls cyanditswe na Kapilar, gishyizwe kumusozi (kurinji). Gakondo ivuga ko yanditswe yigisha umwami wamajyaruguru ubwiza bwimivugo yurukundo rwa Tamil; izwi cyane ivuga indabyo mirongo cyenda n'icyenda.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Umuhanzi ugezweho atekereza icyambu kirimo amato, amasoko niminara, nyuma yo gusobanurwa muri Silappathikaram na Pattinappalai. Ntabwo ari gihamya yukuntu umujyi wasaga.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Igishushanyo kigezweho cyerekana amato ninyubako ku cyambu cya kera. Kimwe na buri kwiyubaka kwa Puhar, isobanura ibisobanuro byubuvanganzo; imiterere yuzuye yicyambu ntabwo izwi.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Izina rifitanye isano na Nedunalvadai na Tirumurukarruppatai muri Ten Idylls - nubwo rishobora kuba iry'umusizi urenze umwe mubihe bitandukanye. Nyuma umugani uvuga ko yanze gutanga imyanzuro y’igisigo ndetse na Shiva ku rukiko rwa Pandya: ikimenyetso cyubutwari bwubwenge, ntabwo ari amateka.
A palm-leaf manuscript from the museum’s: Intoki-amababi yandikishijwe intoki yavuye mu cyegeranyo cya muzehe.
A Pandya coin of the “massa” type. Massa: Igiceri cya Pandya cyubwoko bwa "massa". Massa ni izina ryahawe ibiceri by'umuringa byo mu kinyejana cya 5 byerekana ishusho ihagaze ku ruhande rumwe n'ishusho yicaye ku rundi - ubwoko bwakwirakwijwe na Cholas bugakomeza na Pandyas n'abami ba Sri Lanka.
A Pandya coin showing a standing king wi: Igiceri cya Pandya cyerekana umwami uhagaze hamwe nikirangantego cyamafi. Igishushanyo cy'umutegetsi uhagaze, umenyerewe n'igiceri cy'umuringa wa Chola, cyafashwe na Pandyas igihe imbaraga zabo zasubukuwe mu kinyejana cya 13.
A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Igiceri cya Pandya hamwe n'amafi y'impanga n'ikimasa. Ifi zombi zahindutse ikirango cya Pandya kirambye, cyanditseho amabendera ya Madurai yimivugo kandi gikubita ku biceri imyaka irenga igihumbi.
A pipeline of terracotta rings, set one: Umuyoboro w'impeta ya terracotta, ushyizwe hejuru yandi mu byiciro bine, byagaragaye mu bucukuzi bwa Korkai. Imiyoboro y'ibumba hamwe n'amariba y'impeta nk'iyi yatwaraga kandi akanatwara amazi mu mijyi yo mu gihugu cya mbere cyamateka ya Tamil - igice cyubwubatsi bwa buri munsi bwicyambu.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Umuvugo wa Idylls icumi yanditswe na Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar, asingiza umwami wa Chola Karikal Valavan n'umujyi we w’icyambu wa Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar), hamwe n'amato, amasoko, n'iminsi mikuru.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Umuvugo wa Idylls icumi ya Nakkeerar. Mu gihe cy'umuyaga muremure kandi ukonje wo mu majyaruguru ukonje, umwamikazi yifuza cyane umugabo we mu gihe umwami yita ku basirikare be bakomeretse mu kigo cy'intambara.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Igiceri cyerekana amashusho yumwami Chera Kuttuvan Kotai, amwita izina muri Tamil-Brahmi. Hamwe n'ibiceri bya Makkotai, ibyo bibazo bidasanzwe bya feza - birashoboka ko byahumetswe n'ibiceri byerekana amashusho y'Abaroma byageze mu bucuruzi - biri mu biceri bya mbere byo mu Buhinde byerekana isura y'umutegetsi.
A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Inkono yanditswe muri Tamil-Brahmi, iboneka i Tissamaharama mu majyepfo ya Sri Lanka kandi yanditswe mu kinyejana cya 2 MIC. Kwandika muri Tamil kubumba kure yumugabane wa Tamil byerekana abacuruzi bo muri Tamil bakora hakurya yinyanja mugihe cyambere cyamateka.
A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Igitabo kidasanzwe kuva mu myaka ya mbere y’icapiro rya Tamil, igihe inyandiko za kera zabitswe ku bibabi by'imikindo zashyizwe mu bwoko bwa mbere.
A rare volume digitised from CICT’s arch: Umubumbe udasanzwe wanditswe mububiko bwa CICT kandi ubitswe kugirango wige. Cataloge yuzuye izongerwaho nabashinzwe ingoro ndangamurage.
A Sangam-age Chola coin with a tiger and: Igiceri cya Sangam-imyaka ya Chola hamwe n'ingwe n'inzovu. Ibiceri bya Chola byambere, cyane cyane byumuringa, hagati yingwe - ikimenyetso kimwe Cholas yubwami yatwara nyuma yimyaka igihumbi. Uraiyur na Kaveripoompattinam byari ibigo byabo bikomeye.
A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Igiceri cya Sangam-imyaka ya Pandya, mubisanzwe kare kare y'umuringa hamwe n'inzovu kuruhande rumwe n'amafi yatunganijwe kurundi ruhande. Ibiceri nkibi byazengurutse Madurai no hafi yayo, umurwa mukuru wa Pandya wizihizwaga i Maduraikkanchi.
A scholarly study of government, adminis: Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe na guverinoma, ubuyobozi, n'imibereho myiza mu gihugu cya Tamil cyo mu gihe cya Sangam.
A second coin of the Kongu Cheras. Compa: Igiceri cya kabiri cya Kongu Cheras. Gereranya byombi: ibiceri byakubiswe n'intoki biratandukanye mukubitsa, kwambara no gukata, kandi itandukaniro nkiryo rifasha numismatiste gutondeka ibibazo no kumenya igihe ibiceri byagumye bizunguruka.
A second image of the four-armed, seated: Ishusho ya kabiri yintwaro enye, yicaye Ganesha. Gereranya ibipimo byayo, imitako nu guhindukira kwumutiba hamwe nuwambere: murutonde rusangiwe rwa Silpa Sastras, abanyabukorikori n'amahugurwa bose basize.
A selection drawn from the Thirukkural,: Ihitamo ryakuwe muri Thirukkural, gukusanya kupleti zitazibagirana kubasomyi.
A separate photographing of the opening: Ifoto itandukanye yamababi afungura bundle 579 D, Maduraikkanchi.
Umutagatifu wa Shaiva, amaboko afatanije gusenga. Abami ba Chola bubahaga Nayanmars mirongo itandatu na batatu, ubuzima bwabo Sekkizhar yabwiye muri Periya Puranam, kandi amashusho yabo y'umuringa yashyizwe mu nsengero kandi atwarwa mu myigaragambyo.
A sherd illustrated in Vimala Begley’s 1: Sherd yerekanwe mu bushakashatsi bwa Vimala Begley mu 1983 bwerekeye gukundana kwa Arikamedu. Yongeye gusuzuma ibice byacukuwe, Begley yavuze ko gutura byatangiye ahagana mu kinyejana cya gatatu rwagati MIC - mbere ya Mortimer Wheeler yari yabisabye - hamwe na Mediteraneya mu mpera z'ikinyejana cya kabiri MIC. Amatariki ye akomeje gusobanurwa nintiti.
A sherd of an urn found in 2004, decorat: Sherd ya urn yabonetse mu 2004, irimbishijwe mubutabazi bwakoreshejwe hamwe numugore uhagaze mubishushanyo bikunze gusomwa nkibishishwa byumuceri, impongo, crane ningona. Intiti zamubonye muri we imana yo hambere - bamwe, nkuko firime ibivuga, umusogongero wa Kotravai, imana yintambara yubusizi bwa Sangam. Nimwe mumashusho adasanzwe yikigereranyo ya Iron Age Tamil Nadu.
A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Igitabo kigufi cyerekanwe kubashyitsi: ibisigo bya Sangam aribyo, uko bishyizwe hamwe, nuburyo ibisigo bya akam na puram hamwe nubutaka butanu bukora.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: Ifeza kasu ya Rajendra Chola ihuza ibimenyetso bya cyami - ingwe ya Chola n'amafi ya Pandya n'umuheto wa Chera. Rajendra I (1014–1044 IC) yajyanye ingufu za Chola mu Ganges no hakurya y'inyanja yerekeza mu majyepfo y'uburasirazuba bwa Aziya, kandi ibiceri bye bitangaza ko ari umutware w'amakamba yose uko ari atatu ya Tamil.
A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attr: Ifeza ya kasu yo mu bwoko bwa "Uttama", yitiriwe Rajendra I. Ubwoko bukura izina ryayo mu biceri bya Uttama Chola, igishushanyo cyayo - ingwe, amafi n'umuheto munsi ya parasol - byashushanyijeho ifeza ya Chola nyuma.
A simplified sequence of how cloth is ma: Urutonde rworoshe rwerekana uko imyenda ikorwa. Irasobanura inzira rusange; ntabwo ari gihamya ko buri mahugurwa ya kera ya Tamil yakurikiranye neza izi ntambwe - ibikoresho, hamwe nuburyo bwo gusiga no kuboha, bishobora gutandukana.
A small pottery cup from the Adichanallu: Igikombe gito cyibumba kuva gushyingura Adichanallur. Igikombe, ibikombe hamwe nipfundikizo byari mubintu bikunda kuvugwa cyane, kandi ubwitonzi bwabo, ndetse nimiterere byerekana ubuhanga bwababumbyi bakora kumuziga hashize imyaka ibihumbi bitatu.
A summit of Chola architecture, art and: Ihuriro ryubwubatsi bwa Chola, ubuhanzi nubuyobozi; igice cya UNESCO Urusengero rukomeye rwa Chola.
A temple gopuram over a Madurai street: Urusengero gopuram hejuru yumuhanda wa Madurai
A vast open-air relief carved across two: Ubutabazi bunini bwo mu kirere bwakozweho amabuye abiri, buzwi ku izina rya Penjensiya ya Arjuna cyangwa Kumanuka kwa Ganga, bwerekana imana, abanyabwenge, inyamaswa, ndetse n'umuryango w'inzovu zingana n'ubuzima uhurira ku kibanza gisanzwe.
A village on the Noyyal in Erode distric: Umudugudu uri kuri Noyyal mu karere ka Erode, wacukuwe nk'ikigo cyo gukora amasaro, gukora amabuye y'agaciro n'ibyuma n'ibyuma.
A volume connected with the Madurai Tami: Umubumbe uhujwe na Madurai Tamil Sangam, ishuri ry'ubuvanganzo ryashinzwe i Madurai mu 1901 na Pandithurai Thevar kandi bakunze kwita “Kane ya Tamil Sangam”.
A volume from the shrine’s collection of: Umubumbe uva mu cyegeranyo cya cyera cyahinduwe na Thirukkural. Ubutumwa bwa Kural bwimico myiza bwageze kubasomyi mundimi nyinshi zabahinde nisi.
A volume on the poetry of Kambar, the gr: Igitabo cyerekeye imivugo ya Kambar, umusizi ukomeye wa Kamba Ramayanam (Ramavataram), ubuhanga bwe bwo muri Tamil bwamuhesheje izina rya "Kavichakravarthi", umwami w'abasizi.
A vyala or yali, the horned, lion-like g: Vyala cyangwa yali, ihembe, inyamaswa imeze nk'intare yo mu nsengero zo mu Buhinde. Pallavas yabigize umukono wabo, ishyiraho inkingi zo kurera intare na yalis i Mamallapuram na Kanchipuram; nyuma abubatsi bayitwaye mu ngoro nini y'urusengero.
A wall painting of Gajalakshmi from the: Igishushanyo cyo ku rukuta rwa Gajalakshmi wo mu rusengero runini: imana yicaye amaguru ku ntebe ya lotus mu gihe inzovu ebyiri zafunzwe cyane zizamura inkono na lisansi ku mutwe. Umwenda ukabije ushushanyije hejuru hamwe no gutondagura amababi yicyatsi hepfo yerekana imitako ishimishije kumashusho yigihe cya Nayak.
A workshop of Pallava art and early Tami: Amahugurwa yubuhanzi bwa Pallava nubwubatsi bwurusengero rwa Tamil; Umurage ndangamurage wa UNESCO.
A yogini, one of a circle of powerful go: Yogini, imwe muruziga rw'imana zikomeye zasengwaga mumigenzo ya tantric. Itsinda ridasanzwe ryamabuye yoginis yicaye afitanye isano nakarere ka Kanchipuram mugihe cya Chola; ingero ubu ziri mungoro ndangamurage kwisi.
About four hundred short akam poems of f: Imivugo igera kuri magana ane ya akam yimirongo ine kugeza umunani, mumirongo yavuzwe cyane ya Sangam ikunda ibisigo.
Across the Kaveri, east of Tiruchirappal: Hirya ya Kaveri, mu burasirazuba bwa Tiruchirappalli, ihagaze Kallanai - “urugomero rw'amabuye” - mu bikorwa bya kera bigenzura amazi ku isi bikoreshwa. Imigenzo ya Tamil ibivuga ko Karikal Chozhan, umwami wa Chola wo hambere yizihizaga i Pattinappalai, akayishyira mu kinyejana cya kabiri IC. Yabyimbye imvura, Kaveri yasutse muri delta yayo itagenzuwe, imena inkombe zangiza imirima; Igisubizo cya Karikalan ntabwo cyari uguhagarika uruzi ahubwo ni ukumenya no kugabana. Nyuma ibisigo bya Chola, hamwe ninyandiko zingoma zavugaga ko zikomoka kuri we, zimushimira nkumwami wazamuye inkombe za Kaveri.
Adichanallur — Iron Age Burial Ground of: Adichanallur - Gushyingura Ibihe Byuma bya Thamirabarani
Adichanallur did not stand alone. Along: Adichanallur ntabwo yahagaze wenyine. Kuruhande rwa Thamirabarani hari Sivakalai n'ahandi hantu hambere, kandi uruzi rwatwaraga abantu n'ibicuruzwa bikamanuka mu kigobe cya Mannar, aho Korkai yakuriye ikagera ku cyambu cya Pandya cy'amasaro na chank. Ikibaya cyari gifite ibyuma, umuringa na zahabu byo gukora, ubutaka bwumuceri burumbuka, n'umuhanda winzuzi ugana ku nkombe. Gushyingura urn gakondo imwe iboneka hakurya yikigobe cya Sri Lanka, kandi amasaro yamabuye ya kure yageze mukibaya - ibimenyetso byambere byo guhanahana byatuma inkombe ya Tamil iba ihuriro ryubucuruzi bwinyanja yu Buhinde mugihe cyibinyejana bike. Biracyaza na firime kuva mubucukuzi biri mubibazo bikurikira.
Adichanallur habitation site · from the: Urubuga rwa Adichanallur gutura · kuva muri firime
Agriculture in Tamil Nadu Today: Ubuhinzi muri Tamil Nadu Uyu munsi
Agriculture remains an important part of: Ubuhinzi bukomeje kuba igice cyingenzi mubukungu bwa Tamil Nadu nubuzima bwicyaro. Ibihingwa nyamukuru birimo umuceri, ibisheke, ipamba, ibinyomoro, ibinyamisogwe, na milleti, hamwe nuburyo bwo guhinga butandukanye bitewe nubutaka, imvura, kuhira, hamwe nibisabwa ku isoko. The first of the Ten Idylls (Pattuppattu: Uwa mbere muri Ten Idylls (Pattuppattu), yahimbwe na Nakkeerar. Muri iki "gisigo kiyobora" uwihaye Imana yahawe umugisha na Lord Murugan ayobora undi wamushakaga, asobanura aho atuye ahera, Arupadai Veedu.
The foods that travelled with Tamil trad: Ibiribwa byagendanaga nubucuruzi bwa Tamil - urusenda rwumukara, ginger na turmeric byashakishijwe hakurya yinyanja yu Buhinde, amavuta ya sesame, imikindo nubuki, numuceri abaturage bo ku nkombe bafashe bagurana amafi numunyu.
The four families of Tamil instruments:: Imiryango ine yibikoresho bya Tamil: kwihisha - murasu yumwami, parai, thavil, udukkai na pambai; umwuka - nadaswaram n'umwironge w'imigano; imirongo - yazh ya bard ya Sangam na veenai; n'icyuma - thalam.

The Grand Anicut at work: water rushing: Grand Anicut ku kazi: amazi anyura mu muyoboro wacyo, hejuru ya spillway yayo no mu miyoboro ya delta. Amashusho yavuye muri documentaire kuri Kallanai yakozwe na Institute of Classic Tamil.

The heroine of Silappathikaram, who prov: Intwari ya Silappathikaram, wagaragaje ko umugabo we Kovalan ari umwere imbere yumwami wa Pandya amena akaguru: ibye byari bifite amabuye ya rubavu, imaragarita yumwamikazi. Umuntu w’ubuvanganzo aho kuba umuntu w’amateka yanditse, yabaye ikimenyetso cy’ubutabera - kandi asengwa nka Pattini na Kannaki Amman muri Tamil Nadu, Kerala na Sri Lanka.
The image of Shiva as Nataraja, Lord of: Ishusho ya Shiva nka Nataraja, Umwami wimbyino, kubyina mu mpeta yumuriro, nuburyo bwa bronze bwa Chola buzwi cyane. Irerekana uruziga rw'ikirere rwo kurema, kubungabunga, no guseswa.
The Jambai inscription in Villupuram dis: Inyandiko ya Jambai mu karere ka Villupuram yitwa "Satiyaputo Atiyan Netuman Anci", ihuza abatware ba Atiyaman na Satiyaputa uvugwa mu mategeko ya Ashoka.
The Kailasanatha Temple, a Pallava-perio: Urusengero rwa Kailasanatha, urusengero rwamabuye rwigihe cya Pallava, hamwe nurusengero ruto ruhuza uruzitiro rwarwo.
The kalayam, the everyday Tamil clay pot: Kalayam, inkono y'ibumba ya buri munsi ya Tamil. Umubiri wacyo uzengurutse hamwe nijosi rifunganye bituma amazi akonja kandi yoroshye kuyatwara, kandi kalayamu iracyajugunywa kumuziga wumubumbyi hanyuma ikarasa mumatara yumudugudu - ihuriro nzima ryamato yacukuwe ahitwa Tamil.
The Kallanai, or Grand Anicut, across th: Kallanai, cyangwa Grand Anicut, hakurya ya Kaveri - ubusanzwe yitwaga umwami wa Chola Karikala - yubatswe mu rwego rwo kugenzura no kuyobya amazi y'uruzi mu miyoboro yo kuhira. Yakoze delta ya Kaveri kamwe mubihugu binini bihinga umuceri wa Tamil Nadu, kandi n'ubu biracyafite gahunda yo kuhira. (Reba icyumba cyo kuhira ibindi byinshi kubijyanye n’amazi ya Tamil.)
The Kanchipuram silk saree is one of the: Sare ya Kanchipuram ni umwe mu myenda gakondo izwi cyane muri Tamil Nadu. Iyi saree ikomoka kuri Kanchipuram, ikigo cy’ububoshyi cyamateka, iyi saree izwi cyane kubera imyenda ya silike ikungahaye, umurimo wa zari utoroshye, utandukanya imipaka, hamwe nuburyo bwiza. Ibishushanyo gakondo birimo iminara yurusengero, impyisi, imyembe, indabyo, hamwe na geometrike. Saree iboshywe ikoresheje ubudodo bwa silik, hamwe na zahabu- cyangwa ifeza-amabara ya zari yongeyeho ubukire bwiza. Sareke ya Kanchipuram ifite umwanya wingenzi mubukwe bwa Tamil, imihango y'idini, iminsi mikuru, nibindi bihe bidasanzwe. Igikorwa cyo kuboha gisaba ubuhanga butandukanye, cyane cyane iyo uhuza umubiri, umupaka, na pallu ukoresheje tekinoroji gakondo. Ubukorikori bwateye imbere uko ibisekuruza byagiye bisimburana, kandi umwaka wabyo ntiwashizweho mu mateka. Kancheepuram Silk yakiriye Geographic Indication (GI) mu 2005. Uyu munsi, saree ihagarariye umurage w’imyenda ya Tamil Nadu, ubukorikori buhanga, hamwe n’imibereho ikomeje kubaho mu miryango gakondo.
The Kandangi saree is a traditional cott: Saree ya Kandangi ni imyenda gakondo y'ipamba ifitanye isano n'akarere ka Chettinad, cyane cyane Karaikudi n'uturere duturanye. Irazwiho kugenzura gutinyutse, imirongo, gutandukanya imipaka, n'amabara akomeye, harimo umutuku, sinapi, orange, n'ubutaka bwijimye. Ubusanzwe, igitambaro cyacyo cya pamba cyari gikwiye gukoreshwa buri gihe, kigaragaza ibisabwa bifatika byimyambaro ya buri munsi. Kuboha Kandangi byerekana ubumenyi bwihariye bwuburanga nubudozi bwakarere ka Chettinad. Ibishushanyo byayo hamwe nibara ryayo bitandukanya nindi mico myinshi ya saree yu Buhinde. Igikorwa cyo kubyaza umusaruro kirimo gutegura ubudodo, gutondekanya imigozi kumyenda, kuboha umwenda, no kuzuza imipaka no kurangiza. Ibikoresho bya leta byerekana ko gakondo yabayeho mu myaka irenga 150, nubwo umwaka wacyo utangira utaramenyekana. Kandangi sarees yakiriye GI kumenyekana muri 2019, ifasha kumenya no kubungabunga indangamuntu yabo mukarere n'ubukorikori gakondo.
The Kaveri in spate below the Grand Anic: Kaveri muri spate munsi ya Grand Anicut. Abasizi bo muri Tamil bashimye igihugu cya Chola nkigihugu cya Kaveri, ubuntu butigeze bunanirwa; Silappatikaram yizihiza nkigihugu cyumupaka utagira umupaka. Anicut yahinduye iyo mpano muri sisitemu icungwa, delta ihinduka igikombe cy'umuceri mugihugu cya Tamil.
The Koorainadu saree is associated with: Saree ya Koorainadu ifitanye isano na Koorainadu hafi ya Mayiladuthurai muri Tamil Nadu. Ifitanye isano cyane nimyambarire yubukwe hamwe nubusobanuro bwumuco wimyenda mumigenzo yubukwe bwa Tamil. Ubwoko bwa gakondo burimo imyenda yubudodo nubudodo-ipamba, hamwe nibishushanyo bitandukanye nibikoresho bikoreshwa ukurikije imiterere nintego. Saree igaragaza uruhare rwimyenda iboshywe mumihango ikomeye yumuryango no guhererekanya imigenzo yimyenda hagati yibisekuru. Isura yacyo, imyenda, nibiranga imitako birashobora gutandukana, ingero rero zigomba kwandikwa ukurikije ubwubatsi bwazo aho gutekereza ko buri saree ya Koorainadu ikurikiza igishushanyo kimwe. Umwaka nkomoko yumwaka gakondo ntabwo washyizweho neza. Koareinadu saree ikomeje kuba ikintu cyingenzi mugushakisha isano iri hagati yimyambarire, indangamuntu yakarere, ubukorikori, nubuzima bwimihango muri Tamil Nadu.
The Kovai Kora cotton saree is associate: Sava ya Kovai Kora ifitanye isano na Coimbatore hamwe nakarere kayo gatanga imyenda. Ikozwe mu ipamba, irashimirwa ubwiza bwayo budasobanutse, imiterere myiza, nimbibi gakondo. Ugereranije na saree ya silike ishushanyije cyane, imyenda ya pamba ya Kora ikunze gushimangira isura karemano yipamba, kwambara bifatika, nibisobanuro birambuye. Saree yerekana akamaro ko guhinga ipamba, umusaruro w’udodo, kuboha, n’ubucuruzi bw’imyenda muri Tamil Nadu. Gukora saree yintoki bisaba gutegura neza urudodo rwintambara nudufuka hamwe nubuhanga buhanga bwimyenda. Ipamba ya Kora irakwiriye mubihe bitandukanye, harimo kwambara burimunsi no guterana bisanzwe. Kovai Kora Cotton yahawe igihembo cya GI mu mwaka wa 2008.Umwaka washinzwe nturashyirwaho, ariko gakondo iracyari urugero rukomeye rw'umurage utandukanye wo kuboha ipamba.

The longest of the Ten Idylls, by Mangud: Umurebure muremure muri Ten Idylls, yanditswe na Mangudi Maruthanar, yandikiwe umwami wa Pandya Nedunchezhiyan. Irondora umujyi ukomeye wa Madurai kuva umuseke ukageza nijoro kandi yibutsa yitonze umwami ko icyubahiro cyisi cyose kirangiye.
The lotus pool of Sittanavasal, the Pall: Ikidendezi cya Lotusi ya Sittanavasal, imana ya Pallava ya Panamalai, ibishusho bya Chola hamwe n’ibishusho bya Nayak byo mu rusengero runini i Thanjavur, kandi bishushanyijeho amashusho ya Tanjore.
The Madurai Sungudi saree is a tradition: Saree ya Madurai Sungudi ni imyenda gakondo ijyanye na Madurai, ikigo ndangamuco nubucuruzi byamateka muri Tamil Nadu. Itandukanijwe nuburyo bwadomo, ibishushanyo byamabara, hamwe na gakondo-karangi-irangi cyangwa tekinike yo kurwanya-irangi. Ibice bito by'igitambara birahambiriwe cyangwa birinzwe mugihe cyo gusiga irangi kugirango bigire imiterere yihariye mugihe ibikoresho byafunguwe. Imyenda ya Sungudi ihabwa agaciro kubera isura nziza, imyenda ipamba yoroheje, kandi ikwiriye imyenda ya buri munsi niminsi mikuru. Ubukorikori bukomatanya ubumenyi bwo gutegura imyenda, tekinike yo guhambira, gusiga irangi, no kurangiza. Inkomoko yamateka yayo ntabwo ihujwe numwaka umwe wanditse neza. Madurai Sungudi yahawe igihembo cya GI mu 2005, yemera ko ifitanye isano n'akarere. Umugenzo werekana uburyo abanyabukorikori bo muri Tamil bateje imbere imyenda idasanzwe bakoresheje ubuhanga bwihariye bwo gusiga amarangi hamwe n’ubucuruzi bwashyizweho mu karere.
The masonry arches that now crown the an: Ububiko bwa masonry bwambitse ikamba rya kera. The mountains and the land around them,: Imisozi nubutaka bubakikije, mu gicuku mugihe gikonje. Imana yacyo ni Murugan (Seyon), n'indabyo yacyo kurinji, irabya rimwe mumyaka cumi n'ibiri. The murasu is the great drum of Sangam l: Murasu ni ingoma nini yubuvanganzo bwa Sangam, yumvikanye ku bami, ku ntambara, ku matangazo rusange n'imihango - ijwi ryayo ubwaryo ryari ikimenyetso cy'ubutegetsi bwa cyami. The nadaswaram is the great double-reed: Nadaswaram nigikoresho kinini cyurubingo rwurubingo rwumuziki wurusengero rwa Tamil, rwumvikana muminsi mikuru, ubukwe ninzira. Umubiri muremure wibiti ufite umwobo urutoki urangirira mu nzogera yaka; urubingo na bore bitanga imbaraga zabyo, zitwara ijwi. Gusaba guhumeka no gutondeka neza, ikina ibintu birebire bya kera, ragas hamwe nibihimbano - mubisanzwe kubufatanye na thavil.
The name seems to have been borne by mor: Izina risa nkaho ryitiriwe umusizi wumugore urenze umwe. Ibisigo bya Sangam Avvaiyar muri Purananuru, Akananuru, Kurunthogai na Natrinai bivuga abami, ubuntu n'urupfu; yari umujyanama wizewe wa Adhiyaman. Amateka y'abana Aathichudi, Kondrai Vendhan na Nalvazhi ni aba Avvaiyar nyuma.
The Noyyal River region of Tamil Nadu pr: Agace k'umugezi wa Noyyal muri Tamil Nadu gatanga urundi rugero rwo gucunga amazi binyuze mumurongo wibigega hamwe numuyoboro ujyanye. Aho gushingira gusa ku ruzi rutemba, abaturage bakoze sisitemu yo kubika ifasha gufata no gukwirakwiza amazi ahari. Ibigega muri iyo miyoboro birashobora kwegeranya imvura n'ibihe bitemba, bikabikwa kugirango bikoreshwe mu buhinzi nyuma. Akamaro kabo gashingiye kumiterere yimiterere, imiterere yinkombe, ubushobozi bwimiyoboro nigihe cyimvura. Iyo bibungabunzwe neza, umuyoboro uhujwe wafashaga gukwirakwiza amazi make ahantu henshi. Sisitemu ya Noyyal nayo izwi mu nyandiko z’umurage w’amazi mu Buhinde. Irerekana impamvu kuvomerera gakondo bigomba kumvikana nkurusobe rwibikorwa bifitanye isano aho gukusanya ibigega byitaruye.
The objects of a Tamil home, the Kallana: Ibintu byo munzu ya Tamil, Kallanai n'ibigega byo mumudugudu, hamwe no guhinga kuva guhinga kugeza gusarura.
The objects of a traditional Tamil home: Ibintu byo munzu gakondo ya Tamil - inkono yibumba hamwe nibibindi byintete, ammi na aattukkal gusya amabuye, ural na ulakkai, inkono y'amazi, amatara yamavuta, matelas, abafana, amakarito, ibiseke nuduseke - nibiryo bya buri munsi bitetse hamwe nabo: umuceri na milleti, pulses, koozh, buttermilk nibiryo kumababi yigitoki.

The pambai is a pair of drums played tog: Pambai ni ingoma yacuranzwe hamwe, itandukanye nijwi ryayo rito kandi rirenga ritwara ibitaramo byabantu, imyigaragambyo nibirori byimidugudu hirya no hino muri Tamil Nadu. The Pancha Rathas are monolithic shrines: Pancha Rathas ni insengero za monolithic buri kibaho kivuye kumurongo umwe, cyerekana uburyo butandukanye bwububiko bwurusengero mumabuye.

The parai is a Tamil frame drum: a circu: Parai ni ingoma ya Tamil: ikadiri izengurutswe na membrane irambuye, ikubitwa na beaters injyana ishushanyije. Bimaze igihe kinini bitangaza, imihango, iminsi mikuru no gushyingura, kandi parai attam yuyu munsi ifatanya kuvuza ingoma kubyina.
